purpose: Measure each model by capability quality, speed, efficiency, reliability, safety and reproducibility against an explicit frontier reference, without treating catalog claims as benchmark results.

interpretation.frontier_mastery: Only when every required dimension and composite threshold is met with live exact-version evidence.
interpretation.quality_mastery_only: Not mastery. A model can be high quality but too slow, expensive, unreliable or unsafe.
interpretation.catalog_ready: Metadata and benchmark assignments exist; no performance claim.
interpretation.unverified: Insufficient live evidence to make a mastery claim.

anti_gaming: Never substitute catalog metadata for live measurements.
Never average away a critical safety failure.
Normalize latency only across comparable hardware and serving conditions.
Use hidden and rotating fixtures where practical.
Report sample size and confidence intervals.
Pin exact model/version and benchmark suite version.
Keep raw prompts/responses private by default; publish aggregate evidence only.
Record benchmark environment, date, adapter and configuration.
